syntax = "proto3";

package arr.v1;

import "sbe/annotations.proto";

option (sbe.schema_id) = 3;
option (sbe.version) = 0;

message Key {
  bytes raw = 1 [(sbe.length) = 6];
  uint32 seq = 2;
}

message Record {
  option (sbe.template_id) = 1;
  bytes name = 1 [(sbe.length) = 4];
  bytes uuid = 2 [(sbe.length) = 16];
  bytes signed = 3 [(sbe.length) = 3];
  Key key = 4;
  uint32 tail = 5;
}
